subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 23, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - October 23, 2026

Dear AcreetionOS Community,

We hope this newsletter finds you well. As we continue to work on our project, we wanted to take a moment to highlight some recent developments and updates. First and foremost, we're excited to announce that KeePassXC 2.8.0 has been released, featuring several new features and improvements. You can read more about the update on their official blog.

In other news, we've issued security updates for Thursday, addressing several vulnerabilities in various packages. We recommend that all users update their systems as soon as possible to ensure their security and stability. You can find more information on the AlmaLinux website.

We've also been busy working on our own project, with several commits made to our codebase in the past few days. Our team has been focused on updating our wiki guides, newsletter, and archive, as well as making improvements to our CI/CD pipeline. We're committed to continuously improving our distribution and ensuring that it remains a reliable and secure option for our users.

One of the key areas we've been working on is our AcreetionOS-Xlibre project. We've made several commits to this project, including updating our codebase and making improvements to our release process. We're excited about the progress we're making and look forward to sharing more updates with you in the coming weeks.

We're also happy to announce that our GitLab instance is now up and running, providing a fast and private platform for our community to collaborate and contribute to our project. You can find more information on our GitLab instance and join our community today.

In addition to our technical work, we've also been focusing on building our community and engaging with our users. We're excited to see the growth and enthusiasm of our community, and we're committed to supporting and empowering our users to contribute to our project.

We want to take a moment to thank our community for their continued support and engagement. Your feedback and contributions are invaluable to us, and we're grateful for the opportunity to work together to build a better Linux distribution.

As we move forward, we're excited to continue working on new features and improvements. We'll be sharing more updates and information in the coming weeks, so be sure to stay tuned.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're proud to be working together to build a better, more secure, and more private Linux distribution.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift, Co-Lead Developers of AcreetionOS
